title: Tenant-scoped asset inventory
scope: Assets screen lists only assets accessible to selected tenant and handles empty/error states

criteria.then: Backend-backed names, IDs and site IDs match authorized API exactly

criteria.given: A user is denied cross-tenant access
criteria.when: User attempts a foreign tenant asset request
criteria.then: Server rejects request and UI does not leak data
Accurate empty state shown without fabricated entries
Rows and actions remain accessible, keyboard navigation works

blockers: No real staging database/API/UI browser test evidence
No cross-tenant denial screenshot/log tied to the screen
No user acceptance and persistent restart test
